summary: A git webhook can trigger AAP job templates directly, removing external CI and reducing attack surface; follow git practices (reviewed PRs, inspection tools, no plaintext secrets, pre-commit hooks). Use external credential managers, because controller and EDA credentials passed to the CaC collections are plain text and must not be committed.
questions: Can AAP run job templates from git webhooks?
How do I keep secrets out of AAP configuration as code repos?
Best practices for AAP config as code in git
